name: What are the best questions to ask a custom home builder before signing?

mainEntity.name: What are the best questions to ask a custom home builder before signing a contract in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What are the best questions to ask a custom home builder before signing a contract in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing with a custom home builder in Los Angeles, ask who will run the job day to day, how often you will receive updates, what recent projects match your site and style, and how the builder handles changes after construction starts. You should also ask how they set allowances, whether permits and inspections are included, what items are excluded, who chooses and manages subcontractors, and how warranty claims are handled after move-in. It also helps to ask what long-lead items they expect to encounter and how they protect neighboring properties on tight streets or hillside sites. A strong builder will give direct answers and explain their process clearly. Weak answers, vague pricing, or overly optimistic schedules usually point to future problems. The goal is to understand how the builder actually works, not just how polished the sales presentation looks. These questions help reveal whether the team is built for a complex custom project or only for simpler jobs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask who will manage the site daily, how allowances are set, what is excluded, how change orders work, how the schedule is built, what similar projects they have completed, and how they handle permits, inspections, and warranty issues. Those answers reveal whether the builder is organized and transparent.
